name: Kawahara_2023
partition_info: Complete. Locus names and coordinates for all 391 loci in Table S38 cols 1-3 (nt123, degen, aa; different locus orders). Identical to the atomic ranges of Data.S14 nt321_partitions_models.nex. Codon frame 1 at locus start verified by translation for all 391 loci; L1 (sites 1-657) is COI (invertebrate mito code), all other loci nuclear.
notes: Full verification written up in /home/rob/dataset_search_downloads/Kawahara_2023/README.md (archive, paper, supplement and derived locus tables there). 2258 = 2248 butterflies + 10 outgroups, matches paper. Fig. 1 tree is the aa154 amino-acid analysis dated with treePL (Papilionoidea 101.4 mya). Legacy-gene block 1-3000 is only partly mitochondrial despite the supplement's wording. Tree tip names are renamed and do not match matrix names for ~1200 taxa.

alignment_file: Data_S2_Concatenated_Squam_Concatenated.phy (289 x 481666); per-locus alignments in Data_S1_Aligned_AHA genomic_data_for tree_order.zip (370 files)
partition_info: Complete at locus level: Data_S3_Concatenated_partitioned_models.nex has 370 charsets tiling the matrix, each equal in length to its per-locus file. No codon positions (AHE exon+flank; most loci not in-frame end to end). All nuclear.
notes: Full verification in /home/rob/dataset_search_downloads/Burbrink_2020/README.md (Rob downloaded the Dryad files by hand; paper not in PMC, Rob supplied PDF). 289 taxa match paper; archive has 370 loci vs 394 targets in the paper, but locus length stats match the paper exactly so 370 is the analysed set. Outgroup Sphenodon punctatus. Fig. 1 is a TreePL-dated ASTRAL topology; crown Squamata 190 mya. Methods cite a wrong Dryad DOI (6392n3s).
